thread:
release-manager: Quick heads-up, change window opens in 30m. Canary publish to eu-ecr failed at attestation step — manifest present but cosign attestation absent.

ci-bot: Build #2891 failed: cosign attestation missing, exit 1. Auto-retry disabled for attestation errors.

sam: I inspected the manifest. It has `org.redwood.build.id` but no attestation blob. The attestor VM hit a timeout during signing.

maya: Confirmed. Signer socket timed out on VM. If we push without attestation, deploybot will block promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for `release-v3.8-canary` — policy requires cosign attestation.

ops-jen: Options: re-run build to repro sign (est +6m), pin canary to previous digest so rollout can continue, or escalate for SRE manual override (org policy).

release-manager: Preference: pin to previous digest to keep downstream moving, trigger attestation re-run in parallel, then swap once attestation lands. Note in release-notes as temporary pin.

sre-luis: Fine with pin. After pin and smoke pass, we'll flip to the new attested image. We'll own the postmortem for the signer VM.

sam: Opening PR to pin canary to `sha256:aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff66aa77bb88cc99ddeeff00112233445566778899aa`. Requesting quick review from @ops-jen and @sre-luis.

ci-bot: Push log snippet: ```
./scripts/push.sh eu release-v3.8
Pushing manifest... OK
cosign: error: attestation missing for manifest sha256:...
Exit 1
```

maya: Kicking off attestation rerun now — build #2892 via `gcloud builds submit --config=ci/cloudbuild-attest.yaml --substitutions=_TAG=release-v3.8`. ETA ~7m.

ops-jen: FYI manual `--no-verify` mirror push is blocked for eu until SRE signs off. No ad-hoc bypasses.

deploy-bot: Manual override disabled by org provenance policy. Automated promotion resumes when attestation present or pin merged.

release-manager: Plan: (1) Sam pins canary to prev digest; (2) Maya completes attestation rerun; (3) On attestation arrival we swap canary and update release-notes with a note about the temporary pin and reason. Extending change window +15m.

sam: PR #4027 opened to pin canary -> sha256:aa11bb22... Awaiting reviews, should merge in ~5m if approvals come back.

maya: Attestor connected in build #2892, attestation step running.

sre-luis: After swap we'll run: `curl -sS -D - http://canary.redwood/api/health | grep UP` and a 200->500 qps ramp to validate KV cache warmup.

release-manager: Thanks. Once PR is merged I'll patch release-notes and notify compliance if this impacts any customers. Keep commentary brief in the PR describing the temporary pin and attestation timeline. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Update: build #2892 succeeded and cosign attestation uploaded to eu-ecr.

deploy-bot: Observed attestation on new manifest. Will re-evaluate promotion status once pin PR merges.

sam: PR merged. Patch release-notes with note: "Temporary canary pin to previous digest due to attestor VM timeout; attestation re-run completed and will be swapped after smoke tests."

sre-luis: Running smoke now — basic health OK. Proceeding with controlled swap to new digest and monitoring.

release-manager: Swap done, monitoring metrics. Postmortem ticket created for signer VM timeout. Closing thread after 30m if no regressions.
